Music, tone
Opus had almost nothing above 2 kHz (4 kHz at -33 dB, 8 kHz at -50 dB of the total): a very dark mix. Fable: -27 dB and -42 dB. Still warm, with a little more hammer and air.
Music, touch
In Opus every melody note had the same weight and exact timing. Fable keeps the notes and shapes them: arrivals heavier, passing notes lighter, long notes placed 20 to 40 ms late.
Music, levels
The quietest block sat 9 dB under the loudest in Opus, which risks being lost at game volume. Fable: 7 dB.
Music, motion
Layers switched on and off at block edges; now the arpeggio drifts in and out over two bars, and the left hand answers softly under the melody's long notes.
Sounds, the sound itself

Every generator is rewritten; none is shared with Opus. Strikes use a mode structure per material (log, hollow boards, stone, flesh, soil, clay, iron) plus the noisy contact, and hard things chatter when set down. Leaves, cloth, water and fire are noise whose bands swell independently, not steady hiss.
Sounds, space

Opus put every sound in the same small room, though the game is outdoors. Fable: outdoor sounds are dry with a ground reflection and a faint stereo scatter; only the chest, the cave and the tonal sounds get a room. Files are stereo.
Sounds, palette
Opus used generic marimba and bell tones for rewards and interface. Fable plays them on the soundtrack's own felt piano and soft synth pluck, in the music's notes.
Sounds, rumble
In Opus, 7 sounds had over 6% of their energy under 40 Hz, where it is inaudible and eats headroom (step, tock, click, thud, fallthud, place_path, hurt). Fable: 0.
Sounds, latency
10 Opus sounds took 12 to 58 ms to start (whoosh, flood, crackle, creak, rustle, open, gloom, give, mail, close). Fable: 0. Everything starts within about a millisecond.
Sounds, variants
7 Opus sounds had variants that were the same sound (rustle, creak, gate, write, gloom, whoosh, shout). Fable: 0.
Sounds, loudness
Opus set levels by raw RMS, so variants of one sound differed by up to 3.3 dB to the ear. Fable sets levels with the ear's weighting (BS.1770): 1.6 dB.
Sounds, context
Opus: 66 sounds, 165 files. Fable: 71 sounds, 178 files. New: eating (the game asked for it and had none), watering, filling a bucket, a bare-hand hit, a startled chicken.
Honest limit
This review is by measurement and by reading the generators. Neither model can hear. Your ears decide: use the rows below.
